data.name: Anujaa
data.gender_notes: Anujaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anujaa is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'anu' meaning grace, and 'jaa' meaning to be. The name signifies the one who is pleasing, graceful, and radiant. The name Anujaa carries the meaning “Graceful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anujaa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anujaa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anujaa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
